Orynyx Mindcrawler Fusion Guide

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:15
Instaread

Welcome to the Orynyx Mindcrawler Fusion Guide, where we will provide you with all of the information necessary to complete the April Fusion of 2026!

This Fusion is a Hybrid Fusion, meaning that instead of collecting Rare Champions or Fragments, we will be collecting Fragments for Epics Champions, before ranking them up and fusing the Legendary Champion, Mavara.

Be sure to check back daily to see our breakdown of how many points you will need in each event and the best ways to achieve this.

Orynyx Mindcrawler Guide

Fusion Type: Hybrid

Orynyx is a Hybrid Fusion, rather than the standard ‘Fusion Event’ or ‘Fragment Collector’ we are more commonly used to; this means that instead of collecting Fragments or Champions to fuse him – we get to do both! We will be collecting 4 Epic Champions by collecting 100 Fragments for each of them, which are then fused into Orynyx!

Once you have collected enough fragments for all four epics, you will need to rank them at level 50 and rank 5 and fully ascend them!

These fragments will be collected by completing Fusion Events and Tournaments, which will be rewarded with specific Point Milestones.

One important thing to note with Hybrid Fusions is that, just like Traditional Fusions, you will need to finish this Fusion (and summon them) during the window, which is clearly labelled with a countdown – you CANNOT hold off summoning them for the future, unlike with a Fragment Collector.

Hybrid Fusion Requirements

With Champion Levelling and Ascending still playing a key role in Hybrid Fusions, here is a breakdown of what you will need.

The Champions involved in the fusion are:

  • 4x Primus Atalact

To Rank these to the required level you will need:

  • 16x Rank 4 Chickens

To Ascend these Champions you will need:

Affinity Lesser Greater Superior
Arcane N/A 60 12
Void N/A 80 24

Orynyx’s Skills

Orynyx Fusion Events

As part of the Fusion, we will have 3 summoning events in the Fusion Schedule: two Summon Rushes and one Champion Chase Tournament.

  • Friday, 23rd October – Summon Rush Event
  • Tuesday, 27th October – Summon Rush Event
  • Friday, 30th October – Champion Chase Tournament

With Super-Raids now being a permanent Feature in Dungeons, Plarium used to enable them especially for Fusions; however, we now get special events for each dungeon. These boosts will coincide with their respective Dungeon Tournaments throughout the Fusion Event, giving us increased chances to get specific Artifact Sets!

  • (1) On Thursday, October 22nd, we’re planning to launch x2 event for dropping Speed set artifacts at Dragon’s Lair.
  • (2) On Sunday, October 25th, we’re planning to launch x2 event for dropping Reflex set artifacts at Ice Golem’s Peak.
  • (3) Also, on Wednesday, October 28th, we’re planning to launch x2 event for dropping Savage set artifacts at Fire Knight’s Castle.
  • (4) And moreover, on Sunday, November 1st, we’re planning to launch x2 event for dropping Dark Elves Accessories at Spider’s Den.

Finally, as this Fusion contains several different summoning events, you will need to plan ahead to determine if you can achieve this. We don’t know the exact point requirements for the summon rush so far, but you will need to be prepared. Use our summon rush calculator below to see how many points you can currently earn.

The Fusion Tournaments and Event Points shown in our guide are calculated based on a MAX LEVEL account, however, please note that the points required may vary depending on your account progression, which may mean that you need significantly fewer points than what is displayed in our guide.

Update: Day 1 – Thursday, October 22nd

New Events:

  • Dragon Tournament – 2,250 Points – 25x Fragments (25/400)
  • Gear Hunters Event 1 – 3,700 Points – 25x Fragments (50/400)

It’s time to kick off the Fusion. Off the bat, we are lucky to not have to hold back as the Gear Hunters Event and Dragon Tournament are both active today to put our focus on!

For this Gear Hunters Event, we will need 3,700 points to acquire the fragments (which is a fairly standard amount in fusions these days). This calculates to, on average, 304 runs of Stage 20 Normal Dungeons, and will cost you around 4,864 energy, or 273 runs of Stage 10 Hard Dungeons at 5,460 Energy.

For the Dragon Tournament, you will need to acquire 2250 points, and this calculates to roughly 140 runs of Stage 20 normal at a cost of 2,240 energy or around 120 runs of Stage 10 Hard at a cost of 2,400 energy. Running Stage 20 Normal is the most energy-efficient route when it comes to fusion tournaments (unlike turn attack tournaments which require a high stage). These rates are an average assessment; therefore, some of you may high roll or low roll your gear, requiring slightly fewer or slightly more runs.

Come back tomorrow for more Fusion Updates!
